main_idea: On-policy distillation improves GDPval performance across two model families.
ideas: Distillation raises Nemotron’s GDPval margin and rubric score.
The same recipe raises Qwen’s GDPval margin and rubric score.
Nemotron wins more task comparisons than it loses.
summary: Large model result cards add repeated outcomes above a clear task comparison chart; the graphic is otherwise complete.
